**Role description**  


Shift Timings\- 1:30 PM till 10:30 PM
Joining Location Hyd/Noida

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in both front\-end (Angular) and back\-end (Java) technologies, with a proven track record of delivering scalable, high\-performance enterprise applications
Required Experience
* 8\+ years of professional software development experience
* Strong experience in full\-stack development with Angular and Java
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise\-level applications

Technical Skills: Front\-End Development
* Angular (Expert level): Deep understanding of Angular framework, architecture patterns, and best practices
* State Management: Strong proficiency in NgRX for state management
* Reactive Programming: Expert knowledge of RxJS and reactive programming paradigms
* Testing: Expertise in writing unit and integration tests using Karma and Jasmine
* UI/UX Collaboration: Experience with Figma and ability to work closely with designers to implement pixel\-perfect designs
* Component Architecture: Proven ability to build reusable, self\-contained, and testable components and modules
* Strong understanding of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design principles

Back\-End Development (Java)

Quality Assurance
* Write comprehensive unit tests, integration tests, and end\-to\-end tests using Karma, Jasmine, and JUnit
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards
* Debug and troubleshoot complex issues across the full stack

Collaboration \& Leadership
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including designers, product managers, and other developers
* Mentor junior developers and share knowledge across the team
* Participate in agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning and retrospectives
* Document technical specifications and architectural decisions

Performance \& Scalability
* Optimize application performance and ensure scalability
* Implement caching strategies and performance monitoring
* Design systems that can handle high traffic and large data volumes

Preferred Qualifications
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Experience in the real estate or commercial property management domain
* Exposure to modern front\-end build tools (Webpack, npm, Angular CLI)
* Knowledge of message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka)
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Experience with accessibility standards (WCAG)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Python, SQL
jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.


At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.


**Your Team’s Impact**

This role sits within FactSet's Deep Sector Energy content organisation, as part of the BTU team — named after the British Thermal Unit, the fundamental measure of energy itself, which gives you a sense of how seriously this team takes its domain.  



  

BTU is a distributed team of 8 engineers working across Colorado and India, building the data infrastructure and content pipelines that power FactSet's energy sector offering — one of the most data\-rich and analytically demanding sectors in the investment landscape.  



  

The team's output feeds directly into FactSet's Deep Sector product offering — content that investment professionals across the platform rely on for Oil \& Gas, Power \& Utilities, and adjacent energy verticals.


**What You’ll Do**

The primary focus for this hire is the modernisation of BTU's ETL pipeline — specifically around onboarding and transforming new energy data sources. In practice,
  

that means:


* Re\-engineering and extending ETL workflows across both on\-prem (Wombat / prd\-progs) and cloud (AWS) environments — these complement each other and
* you'll be working across both
* Managing and scaling a significant data ingestion operation — BTU processes data from 1,000\+ sources, spanning a wide variety of vendors, formats, and
* delivery mechanisms including portals, APIs, feeds, and file\-based sources
* Building greenfield pipelines where new data sources have no prior workflow — designing from scratch with scale and reliability in mind
* Integrating AI\-enhanced processes — the team is actively exploring agent\-first architectures to handle automated pipeline breaks and enable self\-healing
* workflows, reducing manual intervention and building systems that fix themselves
* Contributing to a team culture that leverages Claude Code as a standard engineering tool and treats automation of the repetitive and mundane as a first
* principle — not an afterthought
* Writing production\-grade Python and SQL at the core of everything — not as supporting tools, but as primary engineering languages
* Contributing to a team actively raising the bar on data quality, pipeline observability, and system reliability across the energy content stack

This is a role for someone who wants to work on real data complexity — energy datasets are niche, messy, and high\-value. The engineering challenges here are not generic.


**What We are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines and ETL processes, ideally with large datasets.
* You're working in a Python/SQL\-heavy data or backend engineering role at FactSet and want to go deeper into a specialised, high\-value domain
* You have experience with Wombat, Fonix, or prd\-progs orchestration — that context is directly applicable and will accelerate your contribution from day one
* You've worked on ETL pipelines, data transformation, or content engineering at scale and want to push that further in a cloud and on\-prem hybrid environment
* You're interested in agent\-based and self\-healing pipeline architectures — not theoretically, but as live engineering problems you'd be solving
* You're already using or want to work somewhere that has fully embraced AI\-assisted development with Claude Code as a standard part of the workflow
* You want to work in a role where your output is directly visible in FactSet products used by clients every day
* You have an interest in energy as a sector and want to build genuine domain knowledge alongside technical skills — O\&G and Power \& Utilities are among the most analytically rich verticals in the market

**What's In It For You**

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:


* The opportunity to join an S\&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start\-up.
* Support for your total well\-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company\-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

  



**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS \| NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy\-side and sell\-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next\-generation workflow solutions, and c…

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Your opportunity**



The **Senior Engineering Manager, Dirac Query (Query Nexus)** will lead a high\-performing engineering team in **Hyderabad, India,** dedicated to the development, scalability, and execution of batch query processing capabilities. This role is crucial in shaping the entry points, gateway, and batch engine parts of the Dirac Query platform.This position requires a leader who is both technically exceptional in high\-performance distributed systems and deeply committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and collaborative culture across North America and India.


**What you'll do**


**Technical Leadership \& Strategy**
------------------------------------


Drive Engineering Excellence: Lead the technical strategy, design, execution for the Dirac Query systems, and consistent predictable on\-time delivery.  

* 

Robust Platform Development: Ensure high\-availability, scalability, and robust performance of query gateway APIs and execution frameworks.  
* 
* Best Practices: Establish and uphold high engineering standards, including thorough code reviews, robust testing, continuous integration, and comprehensive documentation, and efficient software development processes.

---------------------------------


Nurture High\-Performing Talent: Manage, mentor, and coach a highly skilled local team of Senior Software Engineers, supporting their career growth, setting clear goals, and providing continuous feedback.  

*

*

-----------------------------------------


Bridging Timezones \& Geographies: Establish seamless, respectful communication patterns with North American and European based teams.  

* 

Asynchronous\-First Communication: Champion an asynchronous\-first culture, ensuring that major discussions, design proposals, and key decisions are well\-documented (e.g., in Confluence) so that all team members can contribute regardless of location.  
* 
* Foster Inclusivity: Respect and bridge regional, cultural, and timezone differences, cultivating high psychological safety, mutual trust, and shared accountability.

-------------------------

*

=============================================


Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep technical background in building, operating, and scaling high\-throughput, low\-latency distributed database engines, query compilers and planners, or complex data pipelines.  

* 

Architecture \& API Design: Proven experience designing robust gateway components, entry points, and high\-performance query execution layers.  
* 

Engineering Leadership: 5\+ years of experience managing high\-performing engineering teams with a proven track record of shipping complex, mission\-critical platform initiatives.  
* 

Coaching Senior Talent: Demonstrated ability to guide, challenge, and inspire senior\-level individual contributors (Senior and Lead levels).  
* 

Education: Bachelor‘s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.  
* 

**Cultural \& Leadership Philosophy:**
======================================



We believe that exceptional engineering is built on mutual respect, empathy, and inclusivity. As a leader in Hyderabad, you will be expected to:


Foster Psychological Safety: Maintain an environment where every voice is heard, team members feel safe to take calculated risks, mistakes are treated as learning opportunities, and diversity is celebrated.  

* 

Bridge the Distance: Work closely with US\-based leadership to ensure the Hyderabad team is fully integrated, empowered, and recognized as core co\-owners of the platform.  
* 
* Respectful Collaboration: Champion work\-life balance, flexibility, and respectful collaboration across global timezones. Avoid a “siloed” or “waterfall” task assignment model; instead, maintain a “one\-team” identity.

  

  

**Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.**

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Storable is looking for a Product Manager with a B2B SaaS background to set an outcome \- oriented product strategy. Specifically, you will be working with a highly cross\-functional team to transform Storable CRM product into an industry leading CRM service extensible to each of Storable’s platforms.
 



  

 You will work with colleagues across product, design, marketing, engineering, client success, sales, and the senior executive leadership team to identify potential areas for improvement, define potential solutions and use data\-driven, and lean start\-up principles to drive measurable results. Your success will be measured by how well you drive to organizational success for Storable and for our customers.
 



  

*What you’ll do:*
 ● Transform a strong CRM product to a best\-in\-class solution, extensible to each of Storable’s products giving Storable yet another competitive edge in both Marina and Self\-Storage industries.
   

 ● Lead a cross functional team of support, implementation, sales, marketing, product, engineering, product operations, business operations and design to build processes and coordinate successful rollouts of the Storable CRM on each of Storable’s platforms.
   

 ● Build relationships with storage operators to understand how we can better help their businesses save time and improve profitability through CRM products.
   

 ● Spend considerable time looking at customer behavior metrics from our tools and comparable experiences elsewhere. You will use that insight to validate the right direction for the product.
   

 ● Conduct market research and stay up to speed on the CRM industry to identify new products and potential revenue streams.
   

 ● In collaboration with Product Operation resources, ensure smooth rollout with maximum transparency across the organization.
   

 ● Communicate company\-wide why you are making certain improvements, what you hope to learn from them, and how they fit into your overall strategy.
   

 ● Provide regular updates on projected milestones, progress, and results.
   

 ● Work closely with a product owner to identify opportunities and build a roadmap that strikes the right balance between business and customer value.
   

 ● Objectively measure and broadly communicate the impact of the strategic bets and delivered work.
 



  

*What you’ll need:*
 ● 7\+ years product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
   

 ● Background in card payment processing preferred.
   

 ● Experience working with 3rd party vendors to achieve objectives.
   

 ● Strong cross\-functional organizational skills to manage dependencies and mitigate risks to keep projects on track.
 



 ● Analytical, Understand how to predict, measure and communicate financial impact of changes
   

 ● Ability to navigate hard conversations and build consensus to produce desired outcomes for both Storable and our customers
   

 ● Communication skills to present to a variety of audiences the need for and value of a business case
   

 ● Resourcefulness in solving problems
   

 ● Comfort with both the art (user empathy, design) and science (analytics, statistics, structured hypotheses) of product management
   

 ● Experience working in a nimble product delivery organization where product, design, and engineering work in close collaboration
   

 ● Familiarity working with Agile Scrum methodologies, including the ability to write actionable and detailed user stories
   

 ● Manages projects independently

**Company Description** 




 AbhiBus is a leading online bus\-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators \- including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3\.5 lakh (350,000\+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.
 



  





 AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI\-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms \- ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.
 



  





  





**Job Description** 




**About the role** 




 BusGDS is AbhiBus’s distribution and operations backbone for bus operators — the platform that powers inventory, scheduling, fare and yield management, channel distribution, and settlement across consumer apps, agent network, and external partners. It is the supply\-side engine that thousands of operators and millions of travellers depend on every single day.
 



 As Senior Product Manager for BusGDS, you will own both the strategy and the execution for this mission\-critical B2B enterprise platform. This is a role for a PM who is equally comfortable setting multi\-quarter direction and driving day\-to\-day delivery \- someone who can size a market opportunity in the morning and go deep with engineering on a fare\-calculation edge case the same afternoon.

**What you’ll own**

 • Build the business case for major bets: frame the opportunity, model the impact, and secure alignment from leadership and cross\-functional partners.
 



 • Make deliberate build/buy/partner and prioritisation decisions, and clearly articulate the trade\-offs behind them.
 



**Execution \& delivery**

 platform.
 



 • Own the numbers: define success metrics, instrument the product, and use A/B
 



 testing, usage data, and operator feedback to drive continuous improvement.
 



 • Maintain a high bar for quality and reliability, and unblock the team relentlessly to ship
 



 on time.
 



**Stakeholder \& partner management** 




 • Be the voice of the operator inside the building \- and the voice of BusGDS product to external operators and channel partners.
 



 • Partner with sales, operations, and customer success to onboard operators, drive adoption, and close the loop on feedback.
 



 • Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and trade\-offs clearly to audiences ranging from engineers to senior leadership to external partners.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




**What we’re looking for** 




  





**Must\-have:** 




 • 6–10 years of product management experience, with a strong track record of
 



 shipping successful B2B, enterprise, or multi\-stakeholder platform products.
 



 • Proven strength in both strategy and execution \- you can set direction and own a roadmap, and you can also write the spec and grind through delivery details. We are explicitly looking for both.
 



 • Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; comfortable working directly with data to frame problems and validate decisions.
 



 • Hands\-on with product analytics tools such as CleverTap, Google Analytics, Mixpanel, or Tableau for research, instrumentation, and measurement.
 



 • Hands\-on with wireframing and prototyping tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or similar — and a sharp eye for the difference between good and bad design.
 



 • Technical fluency: able to collaborate credibly with engineering and architecture on APIs, data models, and system trade\-offs on a complex platform.
 



 • Excellent communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to influence without authority across functions and partners.
 



  





**Strong plus** 




 • Travel, mobility, or transportation sector experience — bus, rail, air, hospitality, OTA, GDS, or logistics.
 



 • Experience with distribution systems, inventory or yield management, marketplaces, or other supply\-side / two\-sided platforms.
 



 • Experience building self\-serve tooling, onboarding, or operations platforms for business customers.
 



 • Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
 



 • Prior experience in engineering or a strongly technical background.
 



  





**What success looks like in the first 6–12 months**

jobs.description:
**About Gradera**
=================

  

Gradera defines a new category of enterprise transformation called Software\-Orchestrated Services \- where software orchestrates human expertise, digital workers, and enterprise systems to deliver governed outcomes at scale. As an AI Native Services firm, we help enterprises redesign how work gets done across operations, product, engineering, customer experience, data, and enterprise workflows to move beyond fragmented AI pilots and disconnected automation toward measurable business outcomes.

**About the Role**


We are looking for a hands\-on Scrum Master to support one or more engineering squads working on a complex, product\-grade platform. You will own agile ceremonies, protect the team's focus, and help build a delivery culture grounded in transparency and continuous improvement. This role suits someone who has moved past the basics and is comfortable navigating cross\-functional dependencies, distributed team dynamics, and evolving requirements.
  

  

**Our Agile Stack**

*Methodology*

* Scrum and Kanban for sprint and flow\-based delivery
* Familiarity with scaled frameworks (SAFe or LeSS) for multi\-team coordination
* Agile metrics: Velocity, Cycle Time, Throughput

*Tools*

* Jira and Confluence for backlog management, sprint tracking, and documentation
* Burndown/Burnup charts for delivery visibility
* Collaboration tools like Miro or Mural for remote retrospectives

*Stakeholder \& Planning*

* Sprint\-level capacity planning and dependency tracking
* Regular stakeholder updates translating team progress into delivery outcomes

**Key Responsibilities**

* Run effective sprint ceremonies — planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives — with a focus on outcomes, not just process
* Spot and remove blockers early; escalate when needed without waiting for issues to compound
* Track and report velocity and burndown trends to help the team and leadership maintain realistic delivery forecasts
* Facilitate healthy team dynamics and help resolve interpersonal or cross\-functional friction when it arises
* Coordinate with other Scrum Masters and Tech Leads to manage dependencies across squads
* Maintain a clear backlog alongside the Product Owner, ensuring stories are well\-defined before sprint start
* Communicate progress and risks to stakeholders in plain language

**What We're Looking For**

* 8 \-10 years of overall professional experience, with at least 3 \- 4 years in a dedicated Scrum Master role
* Solid working knowledge of Jira/ADO/GitHub Projects and Confluence — you should be comfortable setting up boards, custom workflows, and basic reporting
* Experience working with or within a scaled agile environment (SAFe, LeSS, or similar)
* Comfortable working with senior engineers and tech leads without needing to manage every technical detail yourself
* Strong communication skills — written and verbal — especially in an offshore\-onsite model

**Good to Have**

* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM I/II, or SAFe SSM)
* Prior experience in product engineering teams, ideally in industrial, logistics, or technology\-heavy domains
* Technical background (developer or SDET) that helps you engage meaningfully in engineering conversations
* Exposure to distributed or India\-US team structures

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Tribute Technology is an established best\-in\-class Software as a Service technology company and solutions provider. Our customers include some of the largest and most prominent media brands in the world, spanning 4 continents and reaching millions of users every day. Our mission is to make meaningful connections between our customers and their users through innovation and a commitment to excellent user experience.
**ABOUT TRIBUTE TECHNOLOGY:**



At Tribute Technology, we make end\-of\-life celebrations memorable, meaningful, and effortless through thoughtful and innovative technology solutions. Our mission is to help communities around the world celebrate life and pay tribute to those we love. Our comprehensive platform brings together software and technology to provide a fully integrated experience for all users, whether that is a family, a funeral home, or an online publisher. We are the market leader in the US and Canada, with global expansion plans and a growing international team of more than 400 individuals in the US, Canada, Philippines, Ukraine and India.


**ABOUT YOU:**



This role is for a Senior Analytics professional who wants to go deep — not across many things, but into a specific domain of a complex eCommerce system and develop real expertise in how it works.



Tribute Technology operates a large, heterogeneous eCommerce portfolio across thousands of websites and multiple technology stacks. You will own a defined sub\-domain of that system — the conversion funnel, for example — and build a thorough understanding of every input that affects it, what normal performance looks like, and how the system responds when things change. The job is to surface intelligence, not to produce reports.



You need to bring meaningful eCommerce analytics experience to this role. The expectation is that you already understand how eCommerce performance works and can apply that understanding to a new and genuinely unusual context. You will work closely with the eCommerce Operations Team Lead and partner with the eCommerce and eCommerce Growth teams.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**


* **Own your domain:**  

	+ Develop deep expertise in an assigned sub\-domain of Tribute's eCommerce system — understand all the inputs that affect performance, how they interact, and what drives outcomes.
	+ Build and maintain baseline models: given observable inputs, what should performance look like? Identify where the system is over\- or underperforming, and why.
	+ Maintain a forward\-looking view of performance in your domain — surface anomalies and emerging trends before they appear in top\-line metrics.
* **Measure what changes:**
  

	+ When changes are made — product updates, platform changes, configuration adjustments — measure how your domain responds and communicate clearly what happened.
	+ Distinguish deliberate change effects from background variation and portfolio mix shifts. Be precise about what the data supports.
	+ Monitor how the system responds to initiatives run by the eCommerce Growth team; provide clean measurement of outcomes within your domain.
	+ Maintain a record of changes, system responses, and learnings over time.
* **Analysis and tooling:**  

	+ Write and maintain SQL across BigQuery and Athena for both recurring analytical work and ad hoc investigation.
	+ Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Power BI and Looker/Looker Studio that surface performance intelligence.
	+ Work within GA4 for behavioral and funnel analysis — event model, path analysis, custom dimensions.
	+ Identify data quality issues in your domain; partner with data engineering to resolve them and distinguish data artifacts from genuine business signals.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**



* **Experience:**  

	+ 7\+ years of hands\-on eCommerce or digital analytics experience.
	+ Track record of going genuinely deep in a specific analytical domain — not broad coverage, but real expertise in how a part of a system works.
	+ Experience working with complex, multi\-source data environments and drawing coherent conclusions across platforms.
	+ Exposure to high\-volume portfolio analytics where aggregate pattern recognition matters more than individual\-unit analysis.
	+ Short\-lifecycle or event\-driven eCommerce experience is a plus.
* **Domain knowledge \& curiosity:**
	+ Solid understanding of eCommerce mechanics — how the funnel works, what drives conversion, how traffic quality and site configuration affect outcomes.
	+ Genuine curiosity about the system behind the numbers; you want to understand why something is happening, not just measure that it is.

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst cum Project Manager with a strong background in managing AI and Digital Transformation initiatives. This role requires expertise in business analysis, project management, stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering, and delivery governance, along with a strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, and automation technologies.

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives and identify AI\-driven opportunities.
* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements, functional specifications, and use cases.
* Conduct workshops, interviews, and requirement elicitation sessions with stakeholders.
* Create Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), user stories, process flows, and use case diagrams.

### **AI Project Governance**

* Support AI solution design discussions and feasibility assessments.

* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), production deployments, and change management activities.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Manage stakeholder expectations and facilitate decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Project Manager, or similar role.

* Understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.

* Experience working with Data Science and AI Engineering teams.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, and responsible AI practices.

**Educational Qualification**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Project Management

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It’s a place where passionate individuals come together to create the future of sport. You will be a senior individual contributor on the squad, working alongside Leads and Principal engineers to deliver complex backend and data systems. You will mentor SWE I and SWE II engineers, drive technical design within your squad, and influence patterns and standards that cross\-squad teams adopt.
  
  

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  

We are looking for senior engineers who own outcomes end\-to\-end — engineers who can decompose ambiguous problems, drive high\-quality designs, and ship complex systems with minimal oversight.
  
  

A minimum of 5–8 years of backend and/or data engineering experience.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

You will lead the design and delivery of significant backend and data services that serve Marketplace and Nike Direct data to BI Experience teams and enterprise consumers.
  
  

You will drive technical design reviews within your squad — choosing patterns, defining contracts, and trading off scope, complexity, and timeline with product partners.

You will collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams and represent your squad in cross\-org technical forums.

jobs.description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people\-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
 



 The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast\-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world\-class solutions in a fast\-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!
 


  
 
 Senior Product Manager \- Intelligent Events, Health, and SLOs
 



  

**Role Summary:** 




 This Senior Product Manager will own the strategy for how SolarWinds defines, measures, and communicates the reliability and operational health of customer systems.  The core focus is transforming raw observability data into actionable, intelligent events and proactive health scores, directly enabling customer Service Level Objective (SLO) management and incident reduction.  This role drives the product vision for event correlation and anomaly detection, ensuring our platform moves customers from reactive monitoring to proactive incident prevention.  Success will be measured by the adoption of SLO features, the reduction in alert volume for customers, and the quality of system health scoring.
 



  

**Core Responsibilities:** 




 Define the product strategy and roadmap for Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs), ensuring seamless configuration, tracking, and reporting for our enterprise users.  Lead the development of the event management platform, focusing on advanced correlation, root cause analysis, and proprietary noise reduction techniques to combat alert fatigue.  Establish a unified, platform\-wide health and risk scoring model that synthesizes metrics, logs, and traces into a single, understandable view of system wellness.  Collaborate with machine learning and engineering teams to integrate AI\-driven anomaly detection and predictive alerting features for the proactive identification of impending issues.  Must be the voice of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) persona, translating industry best practices into powerful, simple\-to\-use product features.
 



  

**Required Qualifications:** 




 Deep domain expertise in AIOps, event management, and Service Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, with specific experience in defining and launching SLO/SLI features.  Proven experience in product managing technical platforms that leverage data science, machine learning, or statistical models for event correlation and anomaly detection.  Strong working knowledge of how observability data (metrics, logs, traces) is used to calculate system health and drive automated workflows.  Must possess impeccable oral and written communications skills, exceptional leadership capabilities to drive cross\-functional alignment, and proven expertise in product strategy and product management fundamentals.  Demonstrated ability to deliver features that fundamentally improve a customer’s operational efficiency and reduce Mean Time to Repair (MTTR).
 



  
 



 SolarWinds is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. SolarWinds will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.
 



 All applications are treated in accordance with the SolarWinds Privacy Notice: https://www.solarwinds.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice

 We build the technology that empowers thousands of frontline peers — trainers, center managers, housekeeping staff, and gym owners — and gives central governance teams real\-time visibility into what's happening on the ground. Think IoT sensors that measure center health, vision\-tech that analyzes CCTV feeds to flag experience issues without human intervention, and workflow automation systems that orchestrate actions across the organization before a single member notices a problem.
 



  





 This is high\-impact, high\-visibility work. The products you build will be used by thousands of Cult.fit employees daily and will directly protect the workout experience of millions of members.
 



  





 We are looking for a Product Manager 2 to own and advance the operations excellence charter. You will be the connective tissue between frontline operations, central governance, process design, engineering, analytics, and UX — translating on\-ground realities into scalable, intuitive technology solutions. You will work with ambiguous, complex operational problems and drive them to crisp, well\-defined product solutions with measurable impact.
 



  





**What You'll Do:**

* Conduct deep user research with diverse stakeholders — from housekeeping staff at a Bengaluru center to senior operations leaders — to understand their workflows, pain points, and what "excellent" looks like in practice.

**What We're Looking For:** 




  




* 3\+ years of experience in product management, ideally within consumer or enterprise applications where operational complexity meets user empathy.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Auric AI** 




 Auric AI is developing the world's most advanced AI\-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications
 



 Defense and military organizations today receive overwhelming volumes of visual data from satellites and drones. Processing this manually is slow, expensive, and error\-prone. Our mission is to use AI\-powered vision systems to detect and classify high\-value military objects such as tanks, artillery, radars, and missile launchers so analysts and commanders can act faster and with greater confidence.
 



  





 We’re a fast\-moving defense technology startup, combining world\-class AI research with real\-world military applications to create intelligence platforms that can make a difference where time and trust matter most.
 



**The Role** 




 We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the development of our Vision Intelligence Platform.
 



 This is not a traditional PM role. You will:
 


* Think from first principles to design workflows that make AI useful in mission\-critical contexts.
* Translate AI research into usable, analyst\-facing products.
* Balance speed, trust, and usability when making product decisions.
* Be AI\-native using the latest AI tools to build wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and demo flows at speed.
* You will own the end\-to\-end product experience: defining workflows, designing intuitive screens, prioritizing features, and ensuring analysts receive intelligence they can trust all within minutes of image arrival.



**What You’ll Do** 



* Vision \& Roadmap


1. Define the product vision and articulate a clear north star for the platform.
2. Build and communicate a roadmap balancing near\-term MVP delivery with long\-term platform growth.


* Workflow \& UX Design


1. Map the full analyst journey: image ingestion → preprocessing → AI detection → quality review → database → dissemination.
2. Work with engineers and designers to create intuitive, analyst\-ready screens.
3. Use AI\-powered tools (e.g., Figma plugins, AI prototyping, AI design assistants) to generate wireframes and demo flows rapidly.


* Feature Prioritization


1. Define MVP scope and ruthlessly separate must\-haves from nice\-to\-haves.
2. Make trade\-offs between speed\-to\-decision, detection accuracy, and user trust.


* Execution \& Delivery


1. Translate requirements into clear PRDs and product specs.
2. Drive collaboration between AI researchers, engineers, and domain experts.
3. Ensure reliability and quality in product releases.


* User \& Stakeholder Engagement


1. Engage with analysts, retired officers, and other stakeholders to understand workflows.
2. Synthesize fragmented feedback into coherent product direction.


* Metrics \& Success


1. Define and track success metrics: time\-to\-insight, adoption, accuracy, and trust in outputs.
2. Use feedback and data to iterate rapidly.



**What We’re Looking For** 



* AI\-native builder: highly proficient in using AI tools for prototyping, wireframing, and creating demo flows.
* First principles thinker who simplifies complex problems into clear workflows.
* Technical fluency: understand how AI and software systems work, even if you don’t code daily.
* User empathy: can design for non\-technical users working under pressure.
* Execution strength: bias for rapid prototyping, iteration, and delivery.
* Communication skills: able to align researchers, engineers, and defense users.
* Prior startup/founder experience or exposure to AI/ML products is a strong plus.



**Why Join Us** 



* Work on one of the hardest, most impactful problems in defense AI.
* Collaborate with a small, world\-class team of researchers and engineers.
* High ownership from day one shapes the platform, not just maintains it.
* Move fast, learn fast, we build, test, and iterate aggressively.
* Be part of a mission\-driven company where AI meets national security.



 Auric AI is building the future of defense intelligence. If you’re an AI\-native product builder who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Shape the future of lending by translating business needs into actionable technology solutions. Collaborate with cross\-functional experts to deliver impactful, compliant, and scalable products.

**The position can be filled in Germany (Erlangen) or India (Bangalore).**

* You have a deep understanding of the development of reporting structures and reporting systems.

* You have a strong passion for the digital data/tool landscape and the analysis of numbers and data.

**Eurofins Scientific** 
 is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
   

  





 The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.
   

  





 In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
   

  





 In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.
